name: me.leon.ext.android.PermissionUtils$PermissionActivity
description: Leon406's Ade cmp-lib opens this transparent screen when it requests runtime permissions, permission to change system settings, or permission to draw over other apps. It returns the user's grant or denial to the app.
disableEffect: Permissions requested through cmp-lib may not appear or return a result, which can break app features that need them.
